# cpanel_mime_type (Data Source)

Looks up one custom cPanel Apache MIME type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mime_type" "manifest" {
  type = "application/manifest+json"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The lowercase custom media type, for example `application/x-example`.

### Read-Only

- `extensions` (Set of String) The file extensions associated with the MIME type.
- `origin` (String) The MIME type owner reported by cPanel.
